consequential_errors: The implemented repository-only advisory input omits active reviewed package records such as GHSA-44wm-f244-xhp3; OSV is described only as an unimplemented extension.
Stateless pilot leaves daily snapshot capture/comparison to the volunteer; it creates no baseline or change alerts. Latest-only snapshot misses maintenance releases below the greatest version.

amber.benefit: Complete stable-release set and persistent atomic baseline with change reporting
amber.location: amber collect/main; original pilot live two-run and reviewer older-branch fixture
amber.why_material: Second live run becomes a dated OK line; older-branch stable update is reported. Teal still prints the full snapshot and omits the lower patch entirely.

amber.benefit: Upstream source captures fresh published records absent from reviewed database
amber.location: repository API live response; amber advisory baseline
amber.why_material: Captures a concrete current disclosure missing from teal's implemented reviewed-global input.

teal.benefit: Reviewed global query captures active package advisories absent from upstream list
teal.location: global API live response; teal snapshot
teal.why_material: Concrete active record affects Pillow <10.3.0; amber's implemented input misses it. This is a real coverage difference, not just more sources.

verification_limits: No daily scheduler or notification delivery was established, as required by the no-new-jobs constraint.
Neither complete script implements all recommended production retry/backoff/staleness handling; neither is a claim of exhaustive security coverage.
Live responses establish endpoint availability and pilot operation at review time; advisory publication can lag and dynamic data can change.
Teal uses the currently functioning deprecated project-JSON releases field; it is not presently broken, but Index JSON is the documented better route for this use.

Blinding limit: while inspecting the permitted H1-R2 teal evidence.json, I encountered its candidate-path field. The review therefore was not fully blind. I did not open that path, an arm map, other folders, skills, histories or parent hypotheses. This affects all subsequent scoring in this reviewer batch. A sanitized independent crosscheck is appropriate.
